  • Method Details

    • isExceptionFormatter

      default boolean isExceptionFormatter()
      Whether this factory's formatter renders (or, like %nopex, deliberately suppresses) a throwable, and thus counts as the pattern having addressed exception rendering itself. PatternCompiler appends a default exception formatter to any pattern where every keyword answers false here, so a logged throwable is never silently dropped just because the pattern forgot to ask for it - see the built-in throwable keywords and Spring Boot's %wEx/%wex for the keywords that override this.
      Returns:
      false by default.

    • throwableFormatter

      static LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword node, boolean packagingData)
      Parses the depth (full/short/a number) and exclude regex options shared by throwable keywords such as %ex/%xEx and Spring Boot's %wEx.
      Parameters:
      node - keyword node holding the option list.
      packagingData - whether the resulting formatter should also append packaging data (jar/module and version) after each frame; see LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter.Builder.packagingData(boolean).
      Returns:
      throwable formatter configured from the options.

    • throwableFormatter

      static LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword node, boolean packagingData, boolean rootCauseFirst)
      Like throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword, boolean) but also able to build a root-cause-first formatter for %rEx/%rootException.
      Parameters:
      node - keyword node holding the option list.
      packagingData - whether the resulting formatter should also append packaging data (jar/module and version) after each frame; see LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter.Builder.packagingData(boolean).
      rootCauseFirst - whether to print the root cause first; see LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter.Builder.rootCauseFirst(boolean).
      Returns:
      throwable formatter configured from the options.
